cases.case_label: SVA_F-derived insertion in APC intron 9 (FAP, patient S5)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2,731-bp 5'-truncated insertion derived from two concatenated SVA_F elements on chr6 (with 82-bp 3' transduction, 24-bp polyA, 14-bp TSD) in APC intron 9 found by targeted adaptive-sampling long-read sequencing; whole-transcriptome sequencing showed significant, specific intron retention near the exon-intron boundary.

cases.case_label: SVA_D/SVA_E-derived insertion in APC intron 8 (FAP, patient S36)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2,678-bp insertion derived from concatenated SVA_D and SVA_E elements on chr12p13 (91-bp 3' transduction, 55-bp polyA, 15-bp TSD) in APC intron 8 of a FAP patient with no other pathogenic variant; its transcript effect was not reported.
